title: Three Autumns and One Short Row
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：fruit　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fruit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my grandfather ① picked a fruit that no picker in the orchard would have named, and he said the picking was the whole of the autumn. The ② fruit, meaning the apple itself and not the tree, ran three autumns and stayed unnamed in the book; a fruit, he said, is the only thing in an orchard that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ fruit in that orchard had the same short row beside it, and the ④ fruit at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fruit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandfather said the naming is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fruit was the whole of the matter, meaning the result and not the apple. The ⑥ fruit, meaning the result and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; fruit, he said, is either something you pick or the only word that means both an apple and a result. He said the result is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ fruit had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short row. The ⑧ fruit of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in October, was one orchard and three autumns of naming; fruit, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fruit I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1971 and is still described as the quietest in the orchard. A ⑩ fruit, my mother said in 1973, is the only one that improves by being named; every fruit, she said, is a result that has agreed to look like an apple. She said the result was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 水果（指果园里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 水果（指那一个本身，与果树相对）
C. 固定搭配：pick a fruit 摘一种水果
D. n. 水果（指留给孩子们的那一种）
E. n. 水果（抽象总称，指一座果园的采果之事）
F. n. 水果（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一种）
G. n. 成果；结果（the fruit of labour，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 成果（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

answers.why: pick a fruit 意为“摘一种水果”，1962 年祖父摘了一种果园里没有一位采摘工肯说出名字的水果。
fruit 意为“水果”，指那一个本身而不是果树，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
fruit 意为“水果”，指果园里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一排矮矮的果树行。
fruit 意为“水果”，指留给孩子们的那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fruit 意为“成果、结果”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份成果就是那件事的全部。
fruit 意为“成果”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那种水果，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fruit 意为“水果”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一种，到 1969 年这一种成了计划里的一行。
fruit 意为“水果”，祖父十月写道，整件事的采果之事是一座果园和三个秋天的说出名字。
fruit 意为“水果”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一种，1971 年结束了，至今仍被说成果园里最安静的一种。
fruit 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，一种水果是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
